question: List one material agreement or other exhibit number explicitly identified in the Exhibit Index (e.g., "Exhibit 10.1: Credit Agreement")—or record "none listed" if no material agreements are identified.
rationale: Started from a greedy set-cover analysis of per-rule individually-solved docs (union=10/18). Initial 4-rule subset satisfied the hard constraint on the first verify. Drop-tests removed rule_8k_exhibit_bylaws then rule_10q_item_6_exhibits while preserving match_rate=1.0; removing the final rule (description_same_span alone) lost 3M_2023Q2_10Q, so 2 rules is the minimum. Final S keeps the two broadest cross-form rules (same-span and item-neighbor-window) covering 10-K/10-Q/8-K patterns.
